title: What Godly Confidence Actually Looks Like (It's Not What You Think)
caption:
Godly confidence doesn't need the room. It's not what you've been sold.

The loudest guy in the room is usually the least sure of himself. Real confidence has nothing to prove.

It survives being wrong. It kneels without losing itself. It doesn't need anyone smaller nearby to feel tall.

He can look any man in the eye and still get on his knees.

#christianmen #godlymanhood #humility #biblicalmanhood #character
